comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling homes to consumers with mortgage and title services; Forestar sells finished lots to builders.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Mainly a homebuilder selling to consumers, with mortgage, title and rental lines; it is Forestar's customer and majority owner.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Production homebuilder selling homes to consumers; it buys lots rather than developing and selling them.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Develops residential land into lots and sells finished lots to third-party builders, though it also builds homes.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling to consumers with design studios and mortgage services; lots are inputs, not the product.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Lot-light homebuilder with mortgage banking selling to homebuyers; does not develop lots for sale to builders.
